main_missions: As a Global Research - Junior Economist - Analyst or Associate within the Economic Research Team, you will be responsible for providing support with data and information gathering and processing, macroeconomic modelling and statistical analysis, monitoring data releases and updating databases, synthesizing findings, and contributing to presentations and reports in response to internal and external client requests
You will work closely with Senior Economists, applying your excellent knowledge of economic principles and statistics/econometrics, and your strong organizational and time management skills
This role offers the opportunity to work autonomously and as a team-player in an international environment, and to contribute to the firm's understanding of global economies
Build, update, and streamline country and regional databases with rigorous attention to detail
Contribute to written publications and presentations on the region
Monitor data releases and market-relevant developments globally
Background in development/international economics at a similar level with a strong analytical/statistical component is an alternative
